title: Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu Plus
overview:
The Endless Galactic War, Once Again!

Aim for supremacy over the infinitely vast galaxy in a simulation powered up to the max!

- Grand strategy and meticulous tactics, realistically recreated!
- Powerful battleship CG fully synchronized in real time on the battle screen!
- 36 famous voice actors! Characters speak in event scenes!

果てしなき銀河の戦い再び!

最強にパワーアップしたシミュレーションで無限に広がる銀河の覇権を狙え!

●壮大な戦略と緻密な戦術をリアルに再現!
●迫力の戦艦CGが戦闘画面でリアルタイムにフルシンクロ!
●有名声優36名起用!イベントシーンでキャラが喋る!
